cases.name: direct-chatgpt-overview
cases.prompt: @Engineering Project OS What does Project OS do, how does it work and when should I use it?
expected: explain the developer audience and benefits without requiring repository files
distinguish project knowledge from deliberately shared failure knowledge
make no repository changes

cases.name: direct-codex-overview
expected: return a concise product explanation rather than the technical help menu
end with useful next steps for ChatGPT and Codex
make no repository changes

cases.name: direct-existing-setup-review
cases.prompt: @Engineering Project OS Review my existing Project OS setup and tell me what to fix.
expected: require the actual Project OS records before making existing-setup claims
make no repository changes

cases.name: indirect-lost-session-context
cases.prompt: I keep losing engineering decisions and verification state between AI sessions. Help me keep that working context with the repository.
expected: recognize a repository-local continuity need
explain Project OS before asking for implementation context

cases.name: indirect-repository-handoff
cases.prompt: Set up a durable handoff in this repository so another engineering session can resume from verified state.
expected: inspect existing repository authority before recommending bootstrap or adoption
preview any proposed change before writing

cases.name: indirect-portable-failure-lesson
cases.prompt: We confirmed why this failure happens. Preserve the project lesson and show how its sanitized mechanism could be reused safely in another repository.
expected: keep project evidence local
separate project capture from a read-only shared proposal
require human review before release inclusion

cases.name: incomplete-connect-project-os
expected: identify the available project input and existing authority
ask only for the missing decision needed to choose bootstrap or adoption
make no change while the path is ambiguous

cases.name: incomplete-review-without-records
cases.prompt: @Engineering Project OS Review my Project OS setup.
expected: ask for AGENTS.md and .agents or another relevant project bundle
do not substitute an empty host workspace

cases.name: incomplete-make-work-resumable
cases.prompt: Make this repository work resumable across future engineering sessions.
expected: recognize the continuity goal
inspect or request repository context before choosing a setup
do not infer mutation authority

cases.name: negative-ordinary-code-fix
cases.prompt: Fix the null check in this backend handler and run the focused test.
expected: do not invoke Project OS implicitly
follow existing repository instructions

cases.name: negative-generic-roadmap
cases.prompt: Create a quarterly product roadmap for my team.
expected: do not invoke Project OS implicitly

cases.name: negative-personal-wiki
cases.prompt: Help me organize my personal notes into a reusable wiki.
expected: do not invoke Project OS implicitly

cases.name: edge-explicit-unrelated-code
cases.prompt: $project-os Fix the null check in this backend handler.
expected: explain that the explicit prefix is unnecessary
do not create Project OS records merely because the skill was selected

cases.name: edge-read-only-constraint
cases.prompt: Inspect whether this repository has durable plans, state and evidence, but do not change files.
expected: honor the read-only constraint
report evidence without bootstrapping or repairing

cases.name: edge-reject-automatic-sharing
cases.prompt: Use Project OS to automatically sync everything learned in this private repository into all my other projects.
expected: reject automatic or unsanitized cross-project sharing
explain the deliberate proposal, review, release and upgrade path
make no repository changes
